title: Cove — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Cove.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Luxury tier. Cove is the dishwasher brand from Sub-Zero Group — born from the same factory that makes Sub-Zero and Wolf. At 40 dBA it is whisper-quiet, with racking designed by the same team that engineers Sub-Zero interiors. Cove dishwashers are panel-ready to disappear into the kitchen, and the premium stainless steel interior outclasses most competitors. Cove exists for one reason: to complete the Sub-Zero/Wolf kitchen.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Anyone buying Sub-Zero and Wolf. Kitchen designers who want a three-brand package from one factory. Customers who want the quietest premium dishwasher.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Cove:

• Completes the Sub-Zero/Wolf kitchen — one factory, one warranty call, one service network

• 40 dBA — quieter than a library, you will forget it is running

• Panel-ready design disappears completely into cabinetry

• Sub-Zero Group factory quality and service — same standards as a $15K refrigerator

• Racking designed for real dishes, not marketing photos — test it with your biggest pots
